request_type: Event: EurILCA EUROPA CUP 2025 Race Number: 1
procedural_matters: EST 224243 - MÜNT did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b)
The Race Commitee was represented by Franjo Juric
Uros Zvan (Member of the Int. Jury) gave evidence as a witness for the RC.
facts: SIs Addendum A.4 requires boats to leave mark 3p on port when sailing from mark no. 2 to the finish.
CRO 224120, CRO 223130, CRO 227745, CZE 223526, EST 224243, CZE 226723 after rounding mark no. 2 left mark 3p on starboard and finished.
CZE 212985 left mark 3p to port and finished
conclusions: By not passing mark 3p on the required side CRO 224120, CRO 223130, CRO 227745, CZE 223526, EST 224243, CZE 226723 failed to sail the course and broke RRS 28.1.
By leaving mark 3p to port CZE 212985 raced in compliance with RRS 28.1 and did not break a rule.
decision: CRO 224120, CRO 223130, CRO 227745, CZE 223526, EST 224243, CZE 226723 are DSQ in race nr. 1.
The Protest against CZE 212985 is dismissed.
